paite: Kumpipa Uzziah asih kum in TOUPA laltutphah sangtak a tawisan a tu ka mu a, apuansilh mong tual in tempul adimsak vek hi.
heading: Pathian In Zawlnei Ding In Isai Asam
english: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

paite: Akiang ah serafte adingh ua; kha guk chiat anei ua, akha nihte un amai uh akhuh ua, nih in akhepekte uh akhuh ua, nih in aleng uhi.
english: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.

paite: Huchi in, "Sepaihte' TOUPA asiangthou hi, asiangthou hi, asiangthou hi: Leitung pumpi athupina in adim," chi in akidawngtuah uhi.
english: One called to another, and said, “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahweh of Armies! The whole earth is full of his glory!”

paite: Huchi in akikou husa in kongpi bul suangphum nangawn alingsak dupdup a, meikhu in insung adim hi.
english: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.

paite: Huaitak in, ke'n, "Muk nin pumi ka hi a, muk ninpu mite lak a teng ka hih ziak in ka tung gik hi na tel e! Mangthang ka hita ve; ka mit in kumpipa, sepaihte’ TOUPA, amuta ngal a," ka chi hi.
english: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, Yahweh of Armies!”

paite: Huchi in serafte lak a khat, maitam a kipan taiteh a teh, mei-am tawi in ka kiang ah ahong leng a, ka kam ahong bi hi.
english: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.

paite: "Ngai in, hiai in na muk asukhata, huchi in na thulimlouhna lakmang ahita, na khelhna leng sawpsiang ahita," achi hi.
english: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”

paite: Huan "Kua ka sawl dia, kou a dia kua kuan ding ahia?" chi in TOUPA aw ka za hi.
english: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?” Then I said, “Here I am. Send me!”

paite: Huchi in ke'n, "Kei hiai ah ka om, hon sawl ve," ka chi hi. Ama'n, "Kuan inla, hiai mite va hilh in, bil in zaw za unla, theihsiam bel theisiam kei un; muh zaw mu unla, theih bel thei kei un, chi in.
english: He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’

paite: Hiai chite lungtang khengsak inla, abil uh ngongsak inla, amitte uh mit sisak in; huchi lou in zaw amit un amu ding ua, abil un aza ding ua, alungtang un athei ding ua, ahong kihei nawn ding ua, damsak in a-om kha ding uh," achi hi.
english: Make the heart of this people fat. Make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.”

paite: Huan ke'n, "Toupa bang tan ahi dia?" ka chi a. Ama'n ahon dawng a, "Khopite a teng ding bei a suksiat a a-om a, innte a mi bei a a-om a, gam loih sipsip a a-om a,
english: Then I said, “Lord, how long?” He answered, “Until cities are waste without inhabitant, houses without man, the land becomes utterly waste,

paite: TOUPA'N mite gamlapi ah asuan a, gamsung a mun paisansa tampi a-om masiah.
english: and Yahweh has removed men far away, and the forsaken places are many within the land.

paite: Huan asung ah sawm lak ah khat leng om lai a-omleh nek khit in a-om behlap ding uhi; himahleh nahhi leh tosaw phuk khit nung a abul a om nilouh bang in chi siangthou abulsum a om nilouh ahi," ka chi hi.
english: If there is a tenth left in it, that also will in turn be consumed, as a terebinth, and as an oak whose stump remains when they are cut down, so the holy seed is its stump.”
